scene yasuamichurch1
I said to thee — o demons, wait. I’m worth your weight in gold.
Ten thousand stone (not jade or slate), and more when you’re alone.
Chameleon, chamele-out. In pages like a leaf.
I’m asleep within my past mistakes. I am pressed between new sheets.

There’s something intriguing about the drip-drop-drip of angels’ tears as they avoid the unmarked graves that grant us air and wind up, almost mysteriously, bent into the same elongated rectangles that dampen our footsteps to keep us from knowing when we’re too close or too far from points A, B, and C.

I come to you now, purer than I’ve been in ages, with tales from a world without erosion. A half-circle hidden behind three full ones above us, not knowing I’m in decimals. It’s a feeling infinitesimal.

The kind you don’t know unless you’re told that you do, so you believe when you are because there are no phases in the lifespan of “weren’t” that make you feel quite as smart as a single well-placed anecdote ever could.
The first time I tasted the body of Christ was at the site of his crucifixion.
We all gathered around to measure his feet after the second Mary commented on their immaculacy to us over what we didn’t know at the time would be our second to last supper.

I still remember the texture of his fallen thorns and how they stuck between my teeth — a sensation so curious that I became furious and couldn’t help but tell the Pilate on the flight back to Judaea.
By the time the fourth cup of wine made its way to me, however, I had more than enough blood in my system. So I bent over backwards and asked to be made into letters as well.

That’s why we can talk now. I’ve achieved a state of being so permanently in-review that I can mold myself into whatever you need to see or hear or think and you can’t tell me I’m wrong because you’re still dressed in weren’t.
Be consumed by my current.
I am strength.
I’m emergent.
: Hah...
Yasu Yasui stands before my duplicated corpse and the symbol of my sacrifice. This is not the site of the thorned one. There are far too few flavors for that and the epilogue is still a world away.
: Blessed be those who give up their eyes.
: Who give up their mouths. Who give up their lives.
: Blessed be those who dream in the pew.
: Who see in the dark.
: Who look just like you.
: Uhh...hello?
scene yasuamichurch2
: My, my...what a pleasant surprise.
: It’s like every day, my dreams move one step closer to reality now.
: I had a feeling you would be here. None of the other churches looked creepy enough.
: To what do I owe the pleasure, child of light? And why, may I ask, have you finally come?
scene yasuamichurch3
: I found a flier near the market by my house and wanted to come get a taste of salvation instead of tomatoes. Where is everyone?
: This is everyone. And oh, how delighted I am to know that my fliers are finally working.
scene yasuamichurch4
: It’d help if you put an address on them and not just the name of your church. This place doesn’t show up on GPS, you know. It goes by some other name and is marked as “permanently closed.”
: It is up to Him to guide lost souls here, for He is the shepherd and I am but one proactive little lamb. I can “baaah” and bleat all day long, but I can never shear myself.
: So you just...wait here all by yourself for someone to show up every day? Isn’t that lonely?
: The voices and the rabbits keep me company. And while their presence isn’t the same as it once was, it’s important for me to remain hopeful. For it is hope itself that brought you here.
: Do you truly wish to taste salvation? To be saved before this is all no more? Because He can help you if you do. And I can show you how.
scene yasuamichurch5
: I...don’t know, really.
: I believe in God. But I’ve never known what God is. And my mom, she...

: I think she believed in...something close to this. There were things in a box of her belongings that looked a lot like your ads. So I figured I...might as well come down and see what this is all about.
scene yasuamichurch6
: You worship some sort of...light. Don’t you?
: Light is the apple. What I worship is the tree.
: You and I are just fruit, you see. The kind one eats off the ground for we will never be as special as those who grow on branches.
: Kind of...demeaning. But I guess that’s par for the course for a religion that, and correct me if I’m wrong here, treats females as beings who need to be ejaculated inside of in order to be saved?
: That is mostly correct, yes.
scene yasuamichurch7
: Neat. And what are your policies on incest?
: It is sinful and impure.
scene yasuamichurch8
: Yeah, on second thought, I don’t know if this is going to work out.
: But...
scene yasuamichurch9
: Hm?

: Even God’s rulebook is not without a long list of clauses. And your situation as a very particular apple who has fallen from a very particular tree would certainly allow a return to your origin point.
: Meaning...that my dad is special and your god will let me have a bunch of sex with him?
scene yasuamichurch10
: See! It is not so hard to understand at all! Yet this very concept seems to perplex so many of our peers! I knew you would be special, Ami! I just knew it!
: You...you did? Then how come you’ve never really, like...tried to recruit me the way you have everybody else? I had to go out of my way to come to you.
scene yasuamichurch11
: In this house, we all do as we’re told.
: I am far closer to an ant than I am a missionary. Such things keep the latter pure to ensure that transference goes as smoothly and pleasurably as possible for both parties.
if amifingered == False:
scene yasuamichurch12
: And if the man who needs to do that in order to save me vehemently refuses, what then? Do I just unceremoniously die and that’s that?
: There is no “death” in this world, child of light — just a different room for those who those who couldn’t find the first.
: You can’t make him save me, then?
: Only He can make anyone do anything. And if it is salvation you seek, surely He would not overlook someone as special as you.
: Yeah, surely. What makes me special, though?
: What do you see in me that no one else does, Yasu? And what do you see in my dad?
: There are fliers all over our neighborhood and I’ve barely even seen them anywhere else. Why are you so desperate to appeal to us? Is it really just because God is telling you to?
else:
scene yasuamichurch13
: Sign me the heck up then. I’ve experienced “transference” so many times now that they’re going to have to make a brand new Heaven just for me.
: I can tell. His scent clings to you like sin does to the dark.
scene yasuamichurch14
: Thank you. I am very proud of that.
: As you should be! For it is the first step of many, but still one that so few dare to take.
: And if you are anything like Sensei, then surely your role in this story is far greater than even mine.
: The black sheep is the most beautiful of them all, Ami. So beautiful, in fact, that it scares away the white ones who fail to understand the contrast between difference and deference.
: That’s why He wants you. Both of you.
: You’re full of colors that no one else has. Colors that would surely spill from you when cut open! Yet you’ve selfishly imprisoned them and-
scene yasuamichurch15
: Yasu? Is something wrong? You stopped complimenting me all of a sudden and I would like you to start again from the top if that’s-
scene yasuamichurch16
: A game!
: I’m sorry?
: A game! We must play a game! It’s the perfect introduction!
: We’ll consult with the Book of Colors to find out how your insides look! Then, you’ll know exactly how special you are without being forced to listen to the input of a lowly foot-soldier!
: I mean...I’m sort of in your hands right now so, if that’s what you think is best, I’m all for it. Why do you need to keep putting yourself down, though?
scene yasuamichurch17
: Down?...
: There’s nothing wrong with being a foot-soldier. And there’s nothing wrong with being an ant. So it hurts to see you talking down on yourself like that when I know you’re trying so hard.
: Yasu-
: You would understand if you knew how big He is. You would know that we are all but ants in comparison. And that it is bad to be one.
: That is how great the divide is, Ami. And I promise you will know in time.
: Well...okay, but-
scene yasuamichurch16
: I’LL GO GET THE BOOK!
scene yasuamichurch18
: I...guess I will go sit down then?
scene black
scene yasuamichurch19
: Okay! Just one more question and we’re all done.
: Have my answers been, like...okay so far? Because I never get the results I want on personality quizzes and I’m starting to think the problem is just me.
: You’re doing wonderful, I think. But I have only done this a handful of times and I can’t fathom a guess of where you’ll end up on the color wheel.
: Do you know your color, Yasu?
scene yasuamichurch20
: Of course I do. It’s 74d9e9.
: Is that the hex code?! The results are that comprehensive?!
: They must be, otherwise we’d end with too many perfect pairs and it would make Him jealous.
: It isn’t often he sees color at all. So when he does, it’s important he sees as many as possible.
: Is it weird that I’m starting to get a little nervous? Like, what if it’s not a color I like? At least if it were something vague like “blue” I could just pick a shade I enjoy.
: I promise you will like the answer. Everyone always likes the answer.
: But...didn’t you just say you’ve only done this a handful of-
scene yasuamichurch19
: Final question — what would your perfect world be like?
scene yasuamichurch21
: You may take all the time you need. I, too, think this is the hardest question on the quiz!
scene yasuamichurch22
: No...it’s not that hard. I was just a little surprised to hear something so grand when all of the other questions have been super weird and specific.
: My perfect world is just one where I’m happy. It’s that simple, really.
: You’re not happy here?
: Are you happy here?
: Wouldn’t it be so much better to have the rest of the seats filled too? To have everyone believe in the same things you do? And not think you’re crazy for just being a little different?
: Happiness is really what matters most at the end of the day. And we only get one life, so if we’re unable to find such a simple thing within it, then what’s even the point?
: Your answer has been recorded! Now please wait one moment while I calculate the results.
: Take as much time as you need. We’ve got plenty of it.
scene yasuamichurch23
: Your color is ff4dd2.
: Oh. That took literally no time at all.
: I had a feeling that’s what it would be before we started. Your hue is rather blinding in the glow of the chapel.
: Can you text that to me, by any chance? There’s no way I’m going to remember it.
: Including the color of one’s light in a mobile message is a third-level sin that I’d need to give up two of my fingernails for. I can send you a postcard, though.
: If that lets you keep your fingernails, sure.
: You mentioned your mother earlier. Tell me more about her.
scene yasuamichurch24
: N...Now? Why? You’ve had all night to ask.

: I did not ask because I already knew. I’ve realized with Touka’s help that such a thing is impolite, though. And I’m trying to remember to ask people more personal questions since that is how one makes friends.
: What do you mean you already knew? Is this one of those “premonition” things of yours that I’ve been hearing about? Because I thought those were all about stuff that hasn’t happened yet.
: You’re both right and wrong all at once.

: Everything that has already happened will surely happen again. And everything that has yet to happen has already happened once. Just as things that are currently happening are also not happening at all!
: It’s all very confusing, isn’t it?
: Yeah, but surprisingly relatable regardless.
: She was an interesting woman, wasn’t she?
scene yasuamichurch25
: Far more than just “interesting.”
: She was talented and beautiful. And her voice...It was so sweet that I can still hear it in my dreams after all this time.
: No one saw the world like her. No one ever will. Not even me...no matter how much I may try to.
scene yasuamichurch26
: After I was born, she found God. But not long after that, she started to lose herself. Started hearing things. Seeing things. Things no one else believed, but things that were very real.
: Is that how it is for you, Yasu? Does it ever get...exhausting? Living in what’s essentially a different plane of existence from everyone else?
scene yasuamichurch27
: Exhausting?...
: I don’t know...
: I have always been this way. The only difference is who the burden I am has shifted to.
: My world has always been wrong in the eyes of others, but it’s everything else that’s wrong to me.
: Yet, everyone says I must change...
: I think that is what is exhausting, Ami.
: People wanted my mom to change too. Heck, there’s a girl living in my house right now that tells me I need to change every single day. But who we are is up to us, isn’t it?
scene yasuamichurch28
: Not me. Who I am is up to Him. I’m not even allowed to read most of the manga Molly recommends to me.
: Oh, right.
: Or masturbate. I can’t do that either.
: Yeah. That was one of the very first things I learned about you.
: It’s so hard being free of sin. But if that is the price I must pay to avoid abandonment, so be it. God is the only one who has never forsaken me, and so I shan’t leave his side no matter what.
scene yasuamichurch29
: You know...you’re actually really cute, Yasu.
: No I’m not. I can’t even brush my hair correctly. Touka must do it for me.
: A different kind of cute. Like the kind a person wants to protect.
: Your god is very lucky to have you.
scene yasuamichurch30
: He’ll be lucky to have you too! For something tells me this is far from your last time coming here. You’ll be back, won’t you?
: Is that okay? Because, if it’s not trouble, I would like to learn more.
: If this is what my mom believed in, I want to at least know what she saw. Because that’s the one thing I’ve just never been able to figure out.
: If that’s what you want, I can tell you right now!
scene yasuamichurch31
: You can? How?
: Give me your hand...
scene black
scene yasuamichurch32
: Girls are special in His all-seeing blindness. And I’ve been granted the ability to carry their message and deliver it unto those who need it most.
: But...this is my hand we’re talking about. So even if something like this lets you, like...see into a person’s mind or whatever, it’s not like you’re communicating with my mom. It’s just me.
: Yes, but you’re your mother’s daughter. Just like your father is-
scene yasuamichurch33
: ...Yasu?
: Is something wrong?
: What do you see?
: Get out.
: What? But-
scene yasuamichurch34
: GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT!!!!!!! AAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!
: Okay...
scene black
: I’m leaving...
scene yasuamichurch35
: I’m sorry.
: You must have seen something terrible.
: I really didn’t mean to scare you. And I will leave you alone now.
: OUT!!!!!! GET OUT!!!!!!!! GO AWAY!!!!!!!!! GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT!!!!!!!!!
: Thank you for today.
scene black
: You don’t need to send me my color.
: But I’d love if you could send me yours.
: I have a feeling it’s beautiful.
